svg.aria-label: VS Code integration view: the UI in the webview calls [Rpc] interfaces through Core's JsonRpcService, whose messages go via postMessage to the extension host, which relays them as LSP notifications over stdio to the language server, where another JsonRpcService dispatches them to the parser, workspace file, cloud sync, Claude and VS Code model services. The language server also runs the MCP server, whose tools ask the open diagram through the same tunnel in the other direction (IModelQueryService, answered by the UI). The extension also sends editor, refresh and search messages to the UI, starts the server, registers the MCP server for Copilot and, when the user connects it, for Claude Code, runs VS Code's language models for the server, and keeps the Clerk token, the Claude key and the MCP token in VS Code's secret storage.
